text: "I……………………………..…………………………………… do solemnly declare and affirm –––––––––––––––––––––––––––– that I will faithfully perform the duties swear and discharge the functions of the office of ………………………………. of Sri Lanka and the law, and that I will be faithful to the Republic of Sri Lanka and that I will to the best of my ability uphold and defend the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka.”
